text.en:
Public defenders of the Deparment of Labor and any agent of the Bureau of Labor thereunto
especially deputed by the Secretary of Labor, the Undersecretary, or the Director of Labor, shall have
authority to administer oaths, issue subpoenas, and take testimony in connection with any case coming within
the scope of their official function.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approval, November 12, 1936.
